# Monthly statements — brief (accepted 2026-09-15)

**Problem:** customers call support on the 2nd of every month asking for their statement.

**Goal:** every active customer receives their monthly statement by email on the 1st, as a PDF
attachment, with no support involvement.

**Success measure:** statement-request tickets drop to zero in the first full month.

**Non-goals:** statement history in the web portal (later).
